FINDING: First three British expeditions to Mount Everest.

Based on the information provided:
Conrad Anker located George Mallory's body lying on Everest in 1999, which was part of a mission organized by the Joint Himalayan Committee. This expedition took place immediately after the failed attempts by Hugh Ruttledge and Percy Wyn-Harris in 1933, indicating that it took place between 1924 (when Mallory made his historic attempt) and 1953 (the year Edgar Morley made Mallory's discovery). Therefore, the earlier expedition falls into 1947.
